feedback.end: Squirrels eat acorns and bury some to save for later. If they forget where they buried an acorn, it will grow into an oak tree!
Tawny owls make their nests in hollow tree trunks. Like many other owls, they are nocturnal. This means they sleep in the daytime and come out at night.
Stag beetles are named after stags because their pincers look like antlers! Stag beetles are endangered in the UK.

atoms.a: The ground in a woodland is home to lots of different plants.
Woodlands can be found all over the UK.
Woodlands are made up of lots of different trees.
